# 3. No sexual content or erotic roleplay (ERP).
This server does not allow pornographic or erotic material in the server’s game chat, Discord, or other various channels. Characters can be in relationships, so long as the round’s emphasis is not entirely on the relationship, and so long as respect to Rule 3 is met. Your characters are working professionals: they work for Nanotrasen, and rounds take place at work. Consider how public displays of affection would be regulated within a work place, even with your married partner.
## Allowed - Character emoting they kiss their partner on the cheek. - Character hugging their partner. - Character hosting a 1 time marriage event in the chapel that lasts less than 15 minutes.
## Not Allowed - Character alluding to sexual content through words or emotes. - Character spending 30 minutes to 1 hour hugging their partner. - Character staging a 2 hour long marriage event that the round revolves around without admin approval. - Posting sexually explicit content of any form, either IC or OOC.
